name: REDD War: Showtime
source: Beloved children's entertainer Mr. Sprinkles is hosting a live show where all the parents will be participating in games for the audience's enjoyment! Unfortunately, this show is being held during the REDD War, an event where creatures like Mr. Sprinkles are free to be their bloodthirsty selves, and he certainly plans to take advantage of it. You have 12 hours to survive this madman's show; can you succeed? No matter what choices you make, this will be a show that nobody will ever forget!
